translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: MATEO
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni MATEO

content: Id Bowiyan ni Disas iddos Minuvu no id Patoy kos Lawa
Na, id sakoy onsi Disas to bollangay woy id livod diyot dipaa to lanow amoy od uli riyot kandin no bonuwa.

To riyon don sikandin, duwon mgo minuvu nid undiyon to kandin no id sayung to minuvu nid patoy kos lawa no id oilogga riyot ikam. To nokita ni Disas no dakkoo kos kodsalig dan, id ikohiyan din iddos novohokan to, “Suwod, yo kod kaanu, su id posinsyan don kos mgo saa ru.”
Na rutun, duwon mgo tohodnonaw to Suhu ni Moises, kohingginawa ran to, “Te, id sosumpalit ikon minuvu, su imman moho to sikandin kos Monama.”
Piru nosorollan ni Disas kos diyot poomdom dan, woy id ikohiyan din sikandan to, “Mambot ungketen kos poomdom dow?
Ingkon man musing kos moomok nod osengon? Idda vo so od ikahi no, ‘Id posinsyan don kos mgo saa ru,’ o iddos od ikahi no, ‘Lohinat woy ipanow ka’?

Piru id pokita ku koniyu no siyak no Anak to Minuvu, duwon kotungud ku ka-ay to ampow't ingod nod posinsya to mgo saa.” Na, id osengan din iddos minuvu no id patoy kos lawa, kahi rin to, “Lohinat ka, piyoddow kos ikam du woy uli kad bo.”
Idda ron en, id lohinat sikandin woy id uli.
To nokita idda to mgo minuvu, nosoobbuwan sikandan woy novaakkan, woy id doong dan kos Monama no id boggoy to kotungud no iling tadda riyon to minuvu.
Dos Kod-umow ni Disas ki Mateo

Na ponayun mid ipanow si Disas pomon dutun, woy nokita rin iddos tohodsukut to buhis no id ngoranan ki Mateo nid ounsad diyot od boovoyaran to buhis. Kahin Disas to, “Duma ka koddi.” De-en id lohinat si Mateo woy id duma kandin.
Nopongnga idda, id ka-an onsi Disas diyot baoy ni Mateo, woy duwon id inguma no mo-uraan tohodsukut to buhis woy duma pon mosaasaa no id lommung nid ka-an duma ki Disas woy taddot mgo tinodduwan din.
To nokita idda to mgo Pariseo, id ikohiyan dan iddos mgo tinodduwan ni Disas to, “Mambo moho to ikos tohodnonaw row, id lommung nid ka-an duwot mgo tohodsukut to buhis woy dumon mosaasaa?”
To norinog idda ni Disas, id tavak din sikandan ukit to ponunggelengan, kahi rin to, “Iddos mgo minuvu no waa bohok, konnod ko-ilangan to doktor, ko konna, idda ra en so duwon bohok.
Ooyyari row tod labbot iddos kohulugan taddot Nosulat no Kahit Monama no mid ungketen to,

content.text: ‘Waa en koru-anon diyot koddi iddos mgo buwis dow. Iyon ku id kopi-i no od ko-eruwan kow to duma.’ ”

content: Na ponayun mid ikahi si Disas to, “Waa a mid undini amoy'd nangkap taddot mgo motallong, ko konna, idda en so mgo mosaasaa.”
Dos Intud Moka-atag to Kodpuasa
Na, duwon mgo tinodduwan ni Juan no Tohodboutismu no id porani ki Disas woy mid intud, kahi ran to, “Sikami woy dos mgo Pariseo, od puasa koy. Piru mambot ikos mgo tinodduwan du, dii man od puasa?”

Mid tavak si Disas to, “Otik duwon kosaa, od kaanu vo iddos mgo oukuy no moranit ginawa taddot lammid osawa laggun to duma ran pa sikandin? Dii en! Piru od inguma kos timpu nod puasa ran otid ongayon don pomon diyot kandan iddos id osawa.”
Dos Moka-atag to Tapoy woy Lammin Nonaw

Na duwon mandon ponunggelengan ni Disas, kahi rin to, “Waa minuvu nod tapong to lammin ogget diyot tapoy'n umpak. Oyya su otid pippiyan don idda, od kipos dos ogget nid tapong, woy od lowwag pe-en kos bendas.

Iling mandad tadda, waa minuvu nod ta-aw to lammin binu nod bovuwak poron diyot tapoy'n tootawwan no binovallan pomot kindaa to oyama, oyyos od bottu en moho idda. Na, od korattan da en iddos tootawwan woy od ko-uwakkan dos binu. Purisu ko-ilangan no iddos lammin binu, diyon en mandad id ta-aw to lammin tootawwan amoy waa od ko-uwakkan.”
Id Badnow ni Disas dos Anak woy id Bowiyan Din iddos Ba-ay

Laggun tid ooseng pa si Disas, duwon id inguma no sokkad no ponguu to simba-an to mgo Judio. Id lingko-od sikandin diyot isowwan ni Disas woy mid ikahi to, “Iddos ba-ay'n anak ku, id patoy gena, piru ahad ungketen, undiyon ka pa woy somaddiyu sikandin amoy'd ko-uyag.”
De-en id lohinat si Disas woy mid duma kandin. Id duma mandad iddos mgo tinodduwan din.

Na laggun tid ipanow ran, duwon sokkad no ba-ay no noosayan to bohok din, su id longossan sikandin no diid soro daom don to sopuu-oruwon lahun. Id porani sikandin diyot inoyyuhan ni Disas amoy'd somaddan din kos ubpu to umpak ni Disas.
Su kohingginawa rin no, “Ahad od pokosomad a ra to umpak din, od ko-uliyan ad en.”
To id loingoy si Disas, nokita rin iddos ba-ay woy kahi rin to, “Uri, yo kod kaanu. No-uliyan kad pomon to kopomakoy ru.” Idda ron en, no-uliyan sikandin.
To id inguma ron si Disas diyot baoy taddot ponguu, nokita rin iddos id lolaantuy atag to kodlobbong woy dos mo-uraan minuvu no id pondaawit.
Id ikohiyan din sikandan to, “Leggua kow pa. Waa id patoy inis anak, ko konna, id tinuhon da.” Piru id kosu-atan dan da en sikandin.
To id ponleggua ron iddos mgo minuvu, mid usok si Disas woy id somaddan din iddos bollad taddot anak, woy id onnow sikandin.
Na, iddos dinoggan moka-atag ka-ay'n notomanan, nokoso-ob diyot intiru taddon ingod.
Id Bowiyan ni Disas iddos Oruwon Butud
Na, to id ipanow si Disas pomon dutun, duwon oruwon mama no butud nid tinundug kandin woy id pomehes sikandan no mid ungketen to, “Lubbad ni David, ko-eruwan ka konami.”

To kod-inguma ni Disas diyot baoy nod undiyonnan din, id porani kandin iddos oruwon butud. Na mid intud si Disas kandan, kahi rin to, “Od pomakoy kow vo nod poko-uli a koniyu?” Mid tavak sikandan to, “Oyya, od Longaggon.”
Na, id somaddan ni Disas kos mata ran woy kahi rin to, “Od kopuungan en ini rinit koniyu pomon to kopomakoy row.”
Idda ron en, nokokita ron sikandan. Kahin Disas kandan to, “Od loglohottan ku sikiyu, no yo row ponudtuu riyot ahad ondoy inis id puungan ku koniyu.”
Piru id ipanow sikandan, woy id so-ob dan da en tid ponudtuu riyot langun dutun no lugaa iddos moka-atag ki Disas.
Id Bowiyan ni Disas iddos Ommow
To mid awa ron iddos oruwa, duwon mandon id inguma riyot ki Disas woy id piyod dan kos minuvun no-ommow su id losuran to busow.

Na nopongnga id poleggua ni Disas dos busow, od poko-ooseng don iddos minuvu. Oray'n nosoobbuwan kos mgo minuvu, kahi ran to, “Kuu! Waa poron kotomanan no iling ka-ay rini to intirut ingod to Israel!”
Piru duwon mgo Pariseo no mid ikahi to, “Od pokopoleggua sikandin to mgo busow, oyyos id boggayan man sikandin to kotuusan ni Moivuyan no ponguu ran.”
Dos Eru ni Disas to mgo Minuvu

Na, id lingkus ni Disas iddos langun no bonuwa woy bariyu taddon lugaa. Id nonaw sikandin diyot mgo simba-an to Judio, woy id ponudtuu rin iddos Moppiyon Dinoggan moka-atag to kodharit Monama, woy id bowiyan din kos nokod-osso-osson bohok.
To nokita rin iddos mo-uraan minuvu, no-eruwan sikandin su id posupittan sikandan woy notompoddan to puhawang iling to mgo karnero no waa tohodtamong.
De-en kahi rin diyot mgo tinodduwan din to, “Iddos mgo minuvu, od poko-iling to ommoy no ollog don nod kottuwon. Oray'n dakkoo kos od kottuwon, piru disok da kos mgo tohodkottu.
Purisu buyuwa row riyot Monama no komunoy taddot ommayon amoy'd popiyod sikandin to mgo tohodkottu.”

footnotes.text: Dos bonuwa nid uliyan ni Disas, idda en so Capernaum.
